name: lumiverse-auto-foley
description: Voice acting and sound effects for your TTS. A second model marks each reply with voice tags and sounds, then your TTS connection in Lumiverse reads it with a voice for every character, persona and NPC. For models that act: ElevenLabs, Fish Audio, Gemini, Chatterbox, OmniVoice and Cartesia.
author: starlitcode

scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:frontend && bun run typecheck:backend
scripts.build: bun run build:frontend && bun run build:backend
